Culture.name: Journalist Attacks

perspectives.title: Journalist Silencing

representative_posts.author: getthebrief.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: When local journalists are silenced, communities lose their eyes and ears on what's actually happening on the ground. That's where power operates without scrutiny.

representative_posts.author: getthebrief.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Community journalists reporting at local and provincial levels bear the brunt of these attacks. They lack institutional protection and legal backing that network reporters have. Most cases never reach national news.

representative_posts.author: getthebrief.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: If community journalists—the ones covering your province and barangay—are silenced without protection, you lose access to what's actually happening on the ground where you live.

representative_posts.author: jimallthetime.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: '... there is a fundamental difference between attacking a newspaper’s reporting and attempting to use the police and threats of litigation against journalists whose investigations have found you out to be a bit fucking dodgy'

representative_posts.author: mel.ge
representative_posts.text: The arrest of journalist Vakho Sanaia is an attack on freedom of speech and a free press. Silencing journalists is not a political tool - it is censorship, and it won't hide the truth. Georgia belongs to no party, and dissent is not a crime. Solidarity with Vakho Sanaia.

representative_posts.author: cascadiarevolting.bsky.social

representative_posts.text: I taught for ten years. Why did I leave? I had parents who never wanted to parent their child and excused their child's bad behavior or put them on Ritalin. representative_posts.author: swanljenn.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The problem with that idea is that teachers don't work standard hours. They spend X amount of time teaching, X amount preparing lessons, X amount marking. Plus parent's evening and pastoral provision. Much of it is outside standard hours. It's not work that can be parcelled up into tasks.

representative_posts.author: economymedicine.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: We do a decent job with math working kids through the process as it advances to higher levels and part of that is making them do it without the machine enough times that they internalize the logic. We probably do need a way to teach simplified versions of what doesn't show up until high level calc

representative_posts.author: aura-olympian.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: or lucky enough, to have good parents and a lot of social opportunities, cannot be expected to know things we are never taught, and which we cannot teach ourselves to do because there are no textbooks, there are no classes that we can take online, these are things learnt by experience.
